body.p: A witch. Once upon a time there lived a man Moreo. He has a wife, a daughter and a son. Once [...].[ShA:] The sense of the sentence is not clear. Moreo only hunts wild reindeer. Autumn has come. Moreo kills wild bulls. Moreo left to hunt. Then Moreo's wife was in the tent. I see a person walking towards our tent. Then that person even entered our tent. I see, he does not look like a human, his all body is covered with hair, he has no clothes. As for me, he looks like a witch. This woman entered the woman's place and sat down on another bed. She says to me: "Let's go for the grass, okay, let's pick the grass." I think, I will not be alive anyway, let's go. Then the girl thinks: "The witch took my mother, she will not come back alive." Then I took my mother's scraper, I took the scythe, I took my mother's comb, I took my mother's thimble. Then I left. Then I look back, the witch is coming to our tent. The witch killed my mother, her hair is visible from the grass, it is dangling. Moreo's daughter ran away from the witch. Then I go, the witch is visible, I threw my mother's scythe, it stood like an iron hill across. The witch left to scratch, it broke her nails. Then I went again, so the witch is there, the giant appeared again. Then I go, my brother said: "She is seen again." Then I threw my mother's comb, it became a forest, after all, the witch was left scratching. I walk, I walk for a long time, ahead on the other side of the river, I see the tent is standing. Then I came to the river, the old man appeared. I cried: "Old man, carry me over the river, give me a boat." The old man came. I said: "Carry me over the river." The old man said: "How is my back?" I said: "Grandfather, your back is like the surface of the lake." The old man said: "Are my legs good?" I said: "Your legs are good, like the legs of a ten hoof riding sledge". The old man carried me over. The witch also came. She cried: "Give me a boat." The old man went out, the old man asked: "How is my back?" The witch said: "Your back is like a scythe handle, it is curve." The old man said: "How are my legs?" The witch said: "Your legs are curve, falling down." At the middle of the river the old man threw the witch into the water, she went down and drowned. The witch said: "I will find you later." The old man said to the children: "Perhaps you should leave. Then I'll leave." The old man said to me: "I will give you an awl." I left. Then the boy said. Then my brother said. "Give me the old man's awl as a toy." I don't want to give it. But then I gave it. I am walking. Then my brother stuck it in himself. Then I think: Where will I bury you? I see, there is a river cape ahead. The boy said: "People who chop the wood will give me a headache."
